name: Andy Levin
summary: Andrew Saul Levin (born August 10, 1960) is an American union organizer, human rights activist, attorney, and politician who served as the U.S. representative from Michigan's 9th congressional district from 2019 to 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, Levin was elected to the House in 2018, succeeding his retiring father, Sander Levin. He is the nephew of the late Carl Levin, formerly Michigan's U.S. senator from 1979 to 2015.
